description: IndexDefinition(definition) normalizes an index definition so one read from a live database (pg_get_indexdef) compares equal to catalog.json's whatever the schema, Postgres version or spelling: lowercase it; replace "on <schema>." (a quoted or plain identifier) by "on "; remove "::text[]" and "::text"; replace "= any (array[" (any spacing) by "in("; remove "using btree"; remove "asc" with the whitespace before it; finally remove all whitespace and the characters " ( ) [ ] ;.

input.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_events_queue_seq ON public.runnerq_events USING btree (queue_name, id)
CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_events_queue_seq ON tenant_42.runnerq_events USING btree (queue_name, id)
CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_events_queue_seq ON "My Schema".runnerq_events USING btree (queue_name, id)
CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_events_queue_seq ON runnerq_events(queue_name, id);

cases.name: IN list as Postgres renders it

input.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_example ON public.runnerq_activities USING btree (queue_name, completed_at DESC) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'failed'::text]))
CREATE INDEX idx_example ON runnerq_activities(queue_name, completed_at DESC) WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed')
CREATE INDEX idx_x ON public.runnerq_activities USING btree (queue_name, COALESCE(scheduled_at, created_at))
CREATE INDEX idx_x ON runnerq_activities (queue_name, COALESCE(scheduled_at, created_at) ASC)

CREATE INDEX idx_runnerq_completed_cron ON public.runnerq_activities USING btree (queue_name, completed_at DESC, created_at DESC) WHERE ((status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'failed'::text])) AND ((metadata ->> 'source'::text) = 'cron'::text))
